title: render is 240 lines and computes the frame and grid a second way
body:
`State::render` in `compositor.rs` runs about 240 lines: overlays and scrim, the drag ghost (70 lines, which also settles `animating`), bars and drop markers, client surfaces, chrome and frame, then GL submit and frame callbacks. It opens with `let State { .. } = self` so `gpu` can be borrowed mutably. That destructure is why `build_frame` is a free function beside `State::frame`, which only forwards to it with the current workspace, and why `render` recomputes `grid` by hand instead of calling `State::grid`. `paint_picker` likewise rebuilds `Grid::new(workspaces.len() + 1, size, cell_height)`, the expression `State::picker_grid` already holds.

## Proposal

Compute the frame and picker grid before the destructure, through `fn frame(&self, workspace) -> Frame` and `picker_grid()`. Extract `paint_ghost(..) -> bool` and `paint_clients(..)`. `render` keeps ordering and submit. `build_frame` and the second grid computation go.
